title: Flat monomorphisms locally of finite presentation are open immersions
statement: Let $f:Y\to Z$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Suppose $f$ is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], and a monomorphism: for every scheme $T$ and morphisms $a,b:T\to Y$, the equality $f\circ a=f\circ b$ implies $a=b$. Then $f$ is an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion].
